description:
Cast Tinder Wall by paying its mana cost.
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
